Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self,value,left=None,right=None): self.value,self.left,self.right=value,left,right

def node_and_leaf_counts(root):
    if root is None: return (0, 0)
    left_nodes, left_leaves = node_and_leaf_counts(root.left)
    right_nodes, right_leaves = node_and_leaf_counts(root.right)
    leaves = 1 if root.left is None and root.right is None else left_leaves + right_leaves
    return 1 + left_nodes + right_nodes, leaves

root=TreeNode(2,TreeNode(1),TreeNode(3))
assert node_and_leaf_counts(root) == (3, 2)
```
explanation: Combine left and right subtree counts. Time O(n), recursive stack O(h). A leaf has neither left nor right child.
